workItems.proposedResolution: Confirm the indicator codebook and map only an authoritative active/inactive customer status. Do not infer status from customer visibility alone.
exitCriteria: Data owner confirms the source field semantics and codebook version.
Mapping tests cover every supported code and fail closed for unknown codes.
Field provenance identifies the authoritative source record and business asOf.

workItems.proposedResolution: Use confirmed CRM contact facts to produce a deterministic summary. Counts alone cannot establish lastContactAt and must not be converted into a fabricated contact timestamp.
exitCriteria: CRM owner confirms count definitions and supplies authoritative last-contact time when required.
The summary contains only deterministic facts and its derivation version is recorded.
WM-GT-01 receives both required fields with provenance.

workItems.proposedResolution: Supply confirmed suitability preference facts from the responsible system. The model and EA adapter must not infer them from balances, holdings or risk level.
exitCriteria: An authoritative source and field codebook are registered.
The current principal is authorized for the selected customer row.
WM-GT-02 receives both fields with business asOf and provenance.

workItems.proposedResolution: Return authoritative business asOf and field provenance. The current updatedAt is retrieval time and cannot be promoted as enterprise fact time.
exitCriteria: Business asOf is returned separately from retrieval observedAt.
Every projected field has source system, source record, asOf and mapping version.
Source result fingerprint changes when authoritative facts change.

workItems.proposedResolution: Expose point lookup by stable customer subject id. Name-based fuzzy lookup remains a locator only and cannot prove identity.
exitCriteria: A stable enterprise subject id is accepted by the point-read tool.
Display name is not used as identity proof.
Subject mismatch and unknown subject fail closed.

workItems.proposedResolution: Authorize the signed Insurance Runtime Principal for a specific customer row and insurance_advisory purpose. Public Demo access is not authorization evidence.
exitCriteria: Organization, principal, purpose and customer row are evaluated by a trusted authorization decision.
Unauthorized and out-of-scope customers return no field values.
Authorization decision fingerprint is included in Gate B snapshot input.

workItems.proposedResolution: Supply renewal, current coverage and minimized claims-risk facts from authoritative policy and claims systems. Raw claim material must not enter customer_profile.
exitCriteria: IA-GT-01 receives all four facts with field-level provenance.
IA-GT-02 receives currentCoverageSummary with field-level provenance.
Claims data is minimized to the approved risk summary.

workItems.proposedResolution: Return authoritative business asOf and field-level provenance for every insurance projection fact.
exitCriteria: Business asOf is distinct from retrieval time.
Every projected field includes source record and mapping version.
The Provider records applied projection and filtered-field count.

workItems.proposedResolution: Register an authoritative cross-system customer identity or make both sources emit the same enterprise subject id. Do not merge records by name, phone or model similarity.
exitCriteria: Both sources resolve to one governed enterprise subject id.
Crosswalk ownership, version and effective time are auditable.
Conflicting or unresolved identity blocks the combined profile.
